Built-in image generation tool was used with the user's supplied image as the style reference.
Final displayed atlas: survivor-atlas-cutout.png. The generated PNG is preserved unchanged; SVG display masks select its character regions.

GENERATION PROMPT
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent 2D game character atlas for a paper-doll NFT game. Use the attached image ONLY as a style/proportion reference: hand-drawn cartoon collectible chibi survivors, huge rounded heads, compact small bodies, black outlines, expressive futuristic costumes, flat cel shading. Create ORIGINAL characters, NOT 3D, NOT voxel, NOT pixel art. Layout: a precisely aligned 4-column by 2-row grid, all 8 cells identical size. Seven full-body front-facing characters occupy the first seven cells left-to-right then top-to-bottom; the final bottom-right cell is EMPTY and transparent. No labels or text anywhere. Each character must have IDENTICAL neutral paper-doll stance, identical head/body/hand/foot positions and bounding boxes: head from 8% to 43% of its cell, torso 43%-66%, arms 46%-72% slightly separated and hanging, legs 65%-88%, feet 88%-94%. Entire character centered in its cell, feet same baseline, hands open or in gloves. Clear transparent gutters and no contact between characters, no ground shadows or scene. Top row: 1 COMMON gray patched scavenger hazmat survivor with rounded blue goggles and respirator; 2 MAGIC ivory bandage-wrapped mummy with pale green alien eyes and purple straps; 3 RARE blue-and-mint cyber survivor with round full-face visor and leaflike shoulder accents; 4 UNIQUE pink astronaut with a glossy large purple/pink helmet, magenta reflective visor, suit panels. Bottom row: 5 LEGENDARY charcoal armored chibi knight, angular horned full-head helmet, red eye slit and orange gauntlet accents; 6 EPIC purple hooded survivor with charcoal gas mask, acid green trim, baggy dark trousers and neon sneakers; 7 MYTHIC elegant black-and-cyan deep-space diver with broad luminous cyan glass visor, bright turquoise gloves and small soft golden insignia, beautiful premium but same simple outline. Keep silhouettes consistent enough to combine heads, torsos, arms and legs from different cells on a single same-sized character. Polished 2D illustrated game assets, thin dark contour linework, tasteful highlights, crisp edge alpha. Transparent background, no checkerboard, no white background, no text, no watermark. Landscape sheet.

FOLLOW-UP PROMPT
Remove background colors, gradients and halos while preserving all seven characters, poses, scale and the 4-column by 2-row arrangement. Transparent background requested. The returned image still included a backdrop, so the application displays character silhouettes through SVG clip paths rather than claiming that the original file contains a transparent background.
